column1: # The score's named events: one row each. nominal = the planned time, kept if the clock lacks the event.
# source tells fit_events.py where to find it in the edit's clock (edit/v7/clock.json):
#   cut:SHOT[+-s]           the cut to SHOT (clock.cuts), plus an offset in seconds
#   next:SHOT               the cut that follows SHOT's cut
#   moment:NAME             clock.events[name]  (the named moments of the edit's config)
#   voice:ID:start|end[+-s] a voice line's speech span in clock.voice
#   ladder:ITEM, ladder_off:ITEM   ladder-events.json beside the clock: when the item lights / goes dark
#   derived / nominal       computed from another event / kept at its nominal time
